calls.reason: Wu et al. find both success on altered tasks and substantial performance drops. That mixed evidence does not settle the blanket denial of reasoning or establish how ChatGPT produced the specific riddle answer.
ARC Prize reports substantial Astra progress without establishing AGI. The symbolic synthesis preprint does not show that neurosymbolic methods are necessary for every route to AGI.

Competition authorities identify incumbent advantages and potential barriers, while Meta reports competitive model capabilities. Neither establishes whether suppliers had durable protection for their generative AI businesses.

The Reuters Institute found weekly generative AI use nearly doubled in 2025, and OpenAI reported continued expansion in June 2026. Growth over nearly two years clearly weighs against the prediction of a near-term flameout.
Marcus frames this as an intuition. OpenAI's September 2025 report confirms persistent but reduced hallucinations; that cannot establish that LLMs will never work reliably.

Meta documents scaling and persistent hallucinations, while Anthropic reports capability gains and Meta describes alternative research. The packet lacks evidence of investment shares needed to assess the overall claim.
